field_principles.field_principles: Each field states the scientific reason that it exists.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Missing hardware or data must stop inference instead of producing invented evidence.
field_principles.inference_substrate: The substrate separates live local generation from cached text or replay.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: The compute class lets blocked work remain distinct from executed generation.
field_principles.execution_venue: The venue identifies where hardware and process isolation were observed.
field_principles.duration_s: Measured wall time makes live execution auditable.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Hashes bind the result to the exact implementation and registry inputs.
field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: Pinned declarations prevent a smaller substitute from entering the run.
field_principles.models_used: Executed model IDs distinguish declarations from actual generation.
field_principles.model_path_receipts: Paths and hashes bind each model ID to exact cached GGUF bytes.
field_principles.gpu_telemetry_rows: In-run samples prove the local generator used the leased RTX 3090.
field_principles.frozen_game_ids: A frozen set prevents outcome-aware game selection.
field_principles.registry_precheck_rows: Registry rows expose exclusions and the mechanic-depth strata.
field_principles.isolation_rows: Process receipts show that policy and public-game implementation stayed separate.
field_principles.forbidden_import_rows: Import receipts expose any adapter or hand-solver access attempt.
field_principles.forbidden_read_rows: Read receipts expose any source, recipe, trajectory, or checkpoint access attempt.
field_principles.per_game_results: Per-game rows prevent one action cell from representing the full frozen set.
field_principles.rows: Canonical decision rows make every aggregate recountable.
field_principles.action_rows: Action rows retain the candidate-to-execution causal chain.
field_principles.simulation_invocation_rows: Invocation rows prove that a forecast was requested before selection.
field_principles.forecast_rows: Forecast rows retain what each model predicted without claiming correctness.
field_principles.forecast_consumption_rows: Consumption rows bind the selected action to its forecast.
field_principles.exact_transition_rows: Exact transition rows prove that a valid action reached the real environment.
field_principles.advice_only_row_count: Advice is not an executable action and must remain visible as failure evidence.
field_principles.valid_action_row_count: The count proves how many rows emitted schema-valid actions.
field_principles.raw_trace_paths: Raw evidence stays outside results until aggregation completes.
field_principles.raw_trace_hashes: Content hashes detect any change after raw trace publication.
field_principles.solve_provenance: Development proxy prevents a public withheld-adapter run from becoming a hidden solve claim.
field_principles.offline_reproduced: Fresh replay is required before an exact transition is credited.
field_principles.arc_registry_delta: A zero delta makes the no-solve boundary explicit.
field_principles.adapter_withheld_live_path_ready_score: Readiness requires both models, valid actions, exact transitions, isolation, and complete ledgers.
field_principles.random_seed: A fixed seed makes game allocation and model sampling repeatable.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: A canonical digest detects later aggregate-field changes.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Exact expected and observed values make every failure actionable.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: False prevents mechanism validation from becoming an ARC correctness claim.
field_principles.verdict_class: A closed class separates positive, null, blocked, and invalid evidence.
field_principles.honest_verdict: A terminal prefix and class token make the conclusion machine-readable.
